name: sd-ai-command-pack-refresh-0-71-2
title: SD AI command pack refresh to 0.71.2
description: Refresh the vendored SD AI command pack in this repository from 0.71.1 to release 0.71.2 for the platforms this consumer is configured for: claude, gemini, github, and opencode. The refresh is driven by the sd-fleet-refresh campaign from the pack source checkout, which owns the install command, the install audit, the candidate checks, and the merge gate; this task exists so the refresh has a Trellis home here for its planning artifacts, journal session, and archive record. Scope is confined to installer-managed output, the regenerated docs/repomix-map.md, the pack manifest and provenance receipts, and this task's own bookkeeping. No product code, test, or configuration changes belong in this refresh. The install audit is the authority on whether the payload landed correctly, and the pull request body must separate copied and generated pack scope from any consumer-authored scope so the remote reviewer does not review vendored pack content line-by-line.
